# LuaSPortFrame:appId

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Get / Set the appId of the frame.

```lua
local appId = frame:appId([appId])
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `appId` | integer | optional |  |

## Returns

appId (integer)
